chronology.reason: Pre-outcome runtime audit found the current LUNARC Phase-2 wrapper creates a venv on demand and installs unpinned current packages (torch, transformers, huggingface_hub, peft>=0.10, accelerate>=0.27). That makes an otherwise frozen five-arm experiment depend on execution-day package resolution. Runtime identity must be frozen before the first outcome-bearing Phase-2 model call.

floating_install_surface: python -m pip install torch transformers huggingface_hub peft>=0.10 accelerate>=0.27
identified_runtime_defect.scientific_interpretation: instrument/runtime portability defect only; not evidence for or against Adaptive-vs-Static

authority_integration_defect.finding: The current canonical positive-bundle admission independently recomputes the statistical result and resource gates but has no runtime-freeze coordinate. Therefore a mathematically positive bundle produced under an unfrozen/floating execution environment could still reach ADAPTIVE_STRUCTURAL.
authority_integration_defect.required_interim_rule: Until a committed approved RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1 exists, canonical Phase-2 activation must retain STATIC_STRUCTURAL even for an otherwise admissible positive synthetic/raw bundle.
authority_integration_defect.required_final_rule: After RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1 is committed, activation must also bind a matching runtime execution receipt to that exact approved freeze digest.

stage_R0_capture.purpose: Run no training and access no Phase-2 model outcomes. On the intended LUNARC A100 path, capture exact Python, CUDA, GPU, module environment, selected critical package versions and a full sorted pip-freeze digest from a pre-existing environment.
stage_R0_capture.required_environment: pre-existing venv only; no package installation or upgrade inside capture job

stage_R1_commit.purpose: Review the R0 capture and commit a separate immutable RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1.json containing the exact accepted runtime values and capture hash before any outcome-bearing model call.

stage_R2_execute.purpose: Outcome-bearing Phase-2 execution may use only a pre-existing environment exactly matching committed RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1.json. No network, pip install, package upgrade, model/runtime substitution or fallback environment is allowed.

interim_activation_gate.reason: No accepted LUNARC runtime capture has yet been committed. This is an execution-readiness gap, not a Phase-2 outcome.

forbidden_after_runtime_capture: select a different runtime because Adaptive/Static outcomes are unfavorable
install a newer package after seeing any Phase-2 model output
switch CUDA/PyTorch/Transformers/PEFT semantics without a new pre-outcome protocol version
reinterpret runtime failure as model/policy efficacy failure
change protocol, inference plan, arms, seeds, MDE, harm gates or parent after runtime capture
activate Adaptive from a positive result bundle that lacks the approved runtime-freeze binding
